units.source_text: “做袋子太可惜，剪开用作茶道的小绸巾又嫌太大，要是做腰带，大概可以做几条吧。”

en.t: It would be a pity to make it into bags, and if it were cut up for small tea-ceremony cloths, the pieces would still be too large. If it were made into sashes, I suppose it could make several.

units.source_text: 千重子有一回把帷幔环视了一圈，这么说道。

en.t: Chieko said this once as she looked all around at the curtain.
